profile.summary:
Backend software engineer with 4+ years at IBM specialized in building and optimizing enterprise-scale systems.
Experience in C/C++ and Python with strong track record of reducing system failure, improving performance, and
deploying APIs. Blends backend expertise with applied AI/ML knowledge to deliver measurable improvements in speed, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

projects.title: Economy Stats AI Overview
projects.description:
📊 Economy Stats AI — Full-Stack News Intelligence Platform (FastAPI + React)

I built Economy Stats AI, a full-stack web app that fetches, filters, and summarizes news articles on economic topics using intelligent agents and asynchronous APIs.

🔹 Tech Stack: FastAPI, React, Tailwind CSS, SQLAlchemy (async), Pydantic, SQLite (PostgreSQL-ready)
🔹 Key Concepts: Async API development, dependency injection, database lifecycle management, component-based UI

🧠 Backend Features:
- Fully async FastAPI backend with request-scoped dependency injection
- Accepts POST requests with topic, from_date, and to_date to trigger an intelligent news pipeline
- Uses agent classes (Selector & Editor) to process and curate article data from an external news API
- Robust validation and filtering logic to persist only complete articles using Pydantic and SQLAlchemy
- Ready for horizontal scaling with Redis or user session support.

💻 Frontend (React):
- Interactive React UI with Tailwind styling
- Displays article summaries and statistics with reusable components and a dynamic carousel
- Makes POST requests to the backend with topic/date inputs and renders returned summaries
- Designed for clean separation of logic and presentational components

💡 I built this project to level up my full-stack skills and better understand async systems, API design, and user-focused UI patterns. IThis project reflects my ability to create scalable and maintainable applications that encompass both backend and frontend development.

Github: https://github.com/sahachel-flores/economy-stats
